title: Bronze Saver Account: Adding authorized users to your account
summary: This document explains how to add authorized users to a Bronze Saver Account, including the limit of up to 2 authorized users. It requires a linked Rho-Bank business checking account in good standing and covers steps to send an invitation, plus how to update or revoke permissions.
